# Exampleton Fast-Track Permits (FICTIONAL TEST DOCUMENT)

This document is invented for automated tests only. It is not a real government document.

The Exampleton fast-track permit process applies to minor works such as front fences, small extensions and signage. A fast-track permit is decided within 10 business days of a complete application being lodged. Fast-track applications are not advertised to neighbours, and the council's chief planner decides the application.

Applicants must lodge a site plan, a written description of the works and the prescribed fee. If information is missing, the clock stops until it is provided.
